citations.sql_query: SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_sales FROM commerce.promotions AS p JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON (oi.promo_id = p.promo_id OR oi.promo_id_2 = p.promo_id) JOIN commerce.orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date AND o.order_date >= '2022-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2022-12-31' GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 100
